privacy: synthetic Quantumult X only — no live subscription URLs or account data

cases.title: Typical managed full configuration
cases.summary: Extracts usable AnyTLS, Shadowsocks, and VMess lines from a full profile and drops banners, a Premium tag, and a duplicate.

cases.title: All seven supported prefixes
cases.summary: Keeps anytls, shadowsocks, vmess, vless, trojan, http, and socks5.

cases.title: AnyTLS standard TLS and Reality
cases.summary: Reality parameters are preserved; they are not metadata.

cases.title: SS2022 and SSR-shaped Shadowsocks
cases.summary: Both lines start with shadowsocks= and are kept.

cases.title: Comments, trimmed duplicates, Traffic stub
cases.summary: Three comment styles and a whitespace-padded duplicate are dropped.

cases.title: English and Chinese account banners
cases.summary: Traffic / Expire / Reset / Days Left / 剩余 / 套餐 / 到期 lines are excluded.

cases.title: [Premium] inside a node tag
cases.summary: Drops that one line without ending the section.

cases.title: [Premium] as a later section header
cases.summary: Terminates [server_local]; later nodes are invisible.

cases.title: Unanchored Reset in a tag
cases.summary: tag=Reset-HK is dropped; a nearby ordinary tag is kept.

cases.title: Days Left versus DaysLeft
cases.summary: Only the single-space phrase Days Left matches the exclusion.

cases.title: UTF-8 BOM and CRLF
cases.summary: BOM is stripped and Windows newlines are normalized.

cases.title: Mixed-case section header
cases.summary: [Server_Local] matches.

cases.title: Indented section header
cases.summary: Leading tabs and spaces before the header are allowed.

cases.title: Section runs to end of file
cases.summary: No following [section] is required.

cases.title: Second [server_local] is ignored
cases.summary: The first match wins.

cases.title: No server_local header
cases.summary: Returns the section-not-found error.

cases.title: Section with no usable servers
cases.summary: Returns the no-usable-server-entries error.

cases.title: Already a server-only list
cases.summary: This parser does not accept bodies that skip [server_local].

cases.title: Header glued to the first server line
cases.summary: A newline after ] is required.

cases.title: Header without a trailing newline
cases.summary: A file that is only [server_local] does not match.

cases.title: Filter rules inside the body
cases.summary: host / ip-cidr lines are unsupported and dropped.

cases.title: Policy lines inside the body
cases.summary: static= and available= are not server prefixes.

cases.title: Unsupported protocol prefixes
cases.summary: hysteria2, tuic, wireguard, https, and socks are dropped.

cases.title: http/socks5 versus https/socks
cases.summary: Only the shorter http and socks5 prefixes are accepted.

cases.title: Tab indentation and IPv6 host
cases.summary: Trim removes tabs; 2001:db8::1 is kept.

cases.title: Spaces around the protocol equals sign
cases.summary: The supported-prefix regex allows optional spaces.

cases.title: Mixed-case protocol names
cases.summary: ANYTLS, Vmess, and ShadowSocks all match.

cases.title: HTML login page
cases.summary: No Quantumult X header.

cases.title: Clash YAML subscription
cases.summary: Wrong format for this parser.

cases.title: Commented header in the preamble
cases.summary: ;[server_local] is not a header. The later real header is.

cases.title: [server local] as a terminator
cases.summary: A spaced name cannot open the section but can close it.

cases.title: Empty body
cases.summary: Missing content is treated as an empty string.

cases.title: Unicode node tags
cases.summary: Hong Kong and Tokyo tags are not metadata exclusions.

cases.title: Free text before the first section
cases.summary: Preamble server-looking lines are ignored until [server_local].
